messages:
katie: Quick check-in — we need to finish asset ingest for the three cloud listings (AWS, GCP, Azure). Legal artifacts, AMI/container IDs, and pricing SKUs should land today. Where are we on each?
raj: Legal: I uploaded the latest T&Cs and privacy addendum to the shared drive but still waiting on SOC2 evidence from infra. Also need confirmation on data residency statement for EU customers.
marco: Packaging/Pricing: I have draft SKUs for Standard / Pro / Dedicated. Need product team to confirm free-trial duration and included vCPU/GPU quotas before I finalize.
sara: Infra/ingest: preparing the manifest and test buckets. Please use the naming convention we agreed: `redwood-listing/<provider>/<build-id>/manifest.json`. Example upload path: `gs://redwood-marketplace/ingest/gcp/1812349999/manifest.json`
alex: FYI I hit a 403 when trying to upload to the AWS staging bucket this morning — looks like the publisher IAM role missing s3:PutObject. I sent a PR with the role update: https://git.internal/r/perms/1234
jen: Support & docs — need final support contact email, SLA wording, and the onboarding runbook. Can someone confirm the primary support alias for the listing?
raj: @katie support alias is `marketplace-support@redwood.ai` (confirmed). On SOC2, infra expects to hand over the report by EOD tomorrow — I'll follow up. For EU residency: we can state "data processed in the EU" for the Azure/GCP regions we specify; ok?
katie: Yep that wording is fine. Marco — can you lock trial to 14 days? Product asked for 14 -> lets finalize.
marco: 14 days works. Also proposing a usage cap of 2,000 token-equivalent requests/hour on the trial tier. If that's fine I'll update SKUs and price tiers.
sara: For ingestion, I'm attaching the manifest template below — please paste the image/logo URLs and the AMI/container IDs into `image_urls` and `artifact_ids`.

sara: ```
{
  "provider": "AWS|GCP|Azure",
  "name": "Redwood Inference",
  "image_urls": ["https://assets.redwood.ai/logo-512.png"],
  "artifact_ids": ["ami-0a1b2c3d","gcr.io/redwood/inference:latest","azure:image:12345"],
  "pricing_skus": ["STD-1","PRO-1","DED-1"],
  "support_email": "marketplace-support@redwood.ai",
  "trial_days": "14"
}
```

alex: Small note — for AWS please also include a `snapshot_id` and `instance_type_recommendation` field. Regionalized AMIs differ.
raj: Legal needs to review the final manifest for any claims language (e.g., "enterprise-grade" / "SLA-backed"). If product wants to use SLA language we need sign-off from sales ops.
marco: Noted — I'll avoid explicit SLA claims in the public listing until we have legal sign-off.
jen: Support runbook request: can someone add a short escalation path in the manifest or attach a runbook link? Prefer call tree + pager rotation link.
katie: @jen I'll drop the runbook link after Marco verifies SKUs. Once manifests are uploaded I'll run the validation script.
sara: Validation command for reference: `python tools/validate_manifest.py --file manifest.json --provider aws`

sara: Also, please upload to the staging bucket paths: `s3://redwood-marketplace/ingest/aws/1812349999/manifest.json` and `gs://redwood-marketplace/ingest/gcp/1812349999/manifest.json` and `https://blob.azure.net/redwood/ingest/azure/1812349999/manifest.json`

alex: After I fixed the IAM role, AWS upload succeeded. I pushed the test manifest to `s3://redwood-marketplace/ingest/aws/1812349999/manifest.json` — leave notifications if you need to re-run validation.

deploy-bot: Task created: marketplace/ingest/1812349999 — checklist: legal artifacts, manifest upload, SKU confirmation, support runbook. Assignee: partnerships-katie. https://tasks.redwood.ai/marketplace/1812349999

katie: Great — plan for today: Raj will follow up on SOC2, Marco finalizes SKUs & pricing, Jen prepares runbook template, Sara will validate manifests once uploaded. If all green we can request publisher account review by EOD. :thumbsup:

raj: I'll ping infra and legal — will update thread when SOC2 is in the drive.

marco: I'll update SKUs in the pricing doc and ping here when done.

jen: I'll scaffold the runbook and drop the link in this thread in ~2 hours.

sara: Doing final validation now. If anyone changes manifest fields please post before 18:00 PT.

katie: Thanks everyone. Quick ask — if you add artifacts, prefix filenames with the ticket id `1812349999_` so we can trace.
